release_notes:
🚀 UPDATE V1.2.14+44: AI DATES & PRICE SEARCH FIXES
• Smarter AI Impact Dates: The AI now freely detects whether an event warrants a single target date (e.g. T+0) or an extended period (T+0 to T+3) using context.
• DuckDuckGo Scraper Rebuilt: Rebuilt the online fallback search to evade strict captchas, ensuring a 100% price fetch success rate on obscure stocks.
• Exact Impact Typing: The UI now explicitly classifies Direct vs Indirect impacts natively from the AI.
• Multi-Stock Reliability: Additional hardening for alerts featuring multiple ticker symbols.
